top_choice_rationale: P001 honours an original classification of electronic phases by a Z2 invariant with a short theory-to-experiment chain (Kane-Mele proposal, Molenkamp's HgTe observation), confirmed for about two decades by transport, photoemission and scanning probes in several material families. The citation scoped to the 2D quantum spin Hall effect matches the three names; the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang omission is a real weakness but does not outweigh the maturity and distinctness from the 2016 prize. P002 (optical lattice clock, Katori and Ye) is a close second with a cleaner two-name allocation but sits nearer to the 2005 and 2012 metrology prizes; both are preferable to no award.
